payload.decision: Pause, but do not close or modify, the unrun T037 structured-decoder draft. Select H030/T038 as a bounded public-mechanism worth audit because the remaining deadline favors source-audited mechanisms already near the public frontier. Public code and artifacts remain quarantined; a T038 pass authorizes only a fresh clean-room E013 implementation and full outer-isolated validation.
payload.rationale: T037 has no active process or scientific outputs and projects close to its four-hour cap. Meanwhile two independent, score-blind local probes of Amer's exact second-order HMM show low error correlation with E011 and exploratory fixed-blend gains of about 2.7-3.3 RMSE. The advertised Sub-6 and Physics notebooks are 92.96% source-similar composite stacks and cannot be trusted as independent unseen-well evidence, but HMM and likelihood-PF are self-contained algorithmic leads worth a bounded falsification screen.
payload.revisit_trigger: Proceed to E013 only if T038 completes every registered branch and control and a fixed globally specified candidate gains at least 1.0 RMSE with at least 4/5 fold-stratum wins, stable tails/edge wells, destructive-control separation, and a projected full-data runtime below four hours. Otherwise reject H030 and resume the next independent public mechanism audit without repairing T038 after scores.
payload.title: Run a bounded public HMM/PF worth audit before any clean-room implementation
